name: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE
summary: WFD UNIBAIL RODAMCO NV WFD UNIB represents warrants for Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield. Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield is a European commercial real estate company. The warrants give the holder the right to purchase shares of Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield under specific terms.
